freezeSemantics.statement: Pilot results qualify only this exact frozen contract (contractId + frozenAtUtc + this document's digest bound in connectivity-aware-sync-cases.json), never every supported organization size or platform. Any change to an outcome name, capability scope, threshold rule, sample rule, missing-data rule, cohort, observation window, denominator, or comparator after results exist is prohibited; a changed comparison needs a new contractId and a new separately identified run, never cherry-picked reuse of results.

capabilityScoping.statement: Every bound outcome names the E4-I/E5 capabilities it applies to; an outcome that is not capability-scoped cannot enter a pilot claim, and a capability that is not admitted to the pilot cannot inherit an outcome.

capabilities.rule: Bounded background metadata work (delta/window sync) while the winning policy mode is execute; admission can only be narrowed by user preference or capability, never broadened.
User-initiated attachment download and verified resume through the dedicated generation-bound transfer route.
Stays never for the pilot unless explicitly widened by a separate recorded decision; it is scoped only for efficiency observations, never for usefulness claims.
Foreground/reconnect mail-list and transfer status projection consumed by webmail; missing background proof never becomes a foreground prerequisite.

outcomeBindings.name: time to useful cached list and time to server-current state

threshold.note: The numeric threshold is baseline-justified from the Q0 record and the E6 paired flag-OFF comparator before outcome collection; numerical defaults are not invented before Q0.

outcomeBindings.sampleRule: All pilot attempts are retained; no post-result workload, metric, seed, or stopping change; no improvement obtained by silently dropping work.
outcomeBindings.missingDataRule: Missing or unmet usefulness evidence holds only the affected expansion or claim, never the OFF implementation, deterministic review, or already qualified foreground/reconnect support.

outcomeBindings.name: resumed bytes versus restarted bytes, resume success, and verified attachment completions/failures per attempt

threshold.note: The numeric threshold is baseline-justified from the Q0 record and the E6 paired flag-OFF comparator before outcome collection; numerical defaults are not invented before Q0.

outcomeBindings.sampleRule: Every completion, failure, timeout, cancel, and expiry is counted separately per attempt; attempts are never merged or dropped after results exist.
outcomeBindings.missingDataRule: An attempt without verified completion proof is reported as failed or unavailable, never inferred as success; missing proof cannot be borrowed from another profile or run.

outcomeBindings.name: bytes transferred per useful opened item

threshold.note: The numeric threshold is baseline-justified from the Q0 record before outcome collection; numerical defaults are not invented before Q0.

outcomeBindings.sampleRule: All pilot attempts are retained and attributed to the capability that transferred the bytes; no post-result workload, metric, seed, or stopping change.
outcomeBindings.missingDataRule: Unattributable or unavailable transfer accounting is omitted and counted, never estimated into a passing value.

outcomeBindings.name: work completion/age by class, including critical starvation count (target zero)

threshold.note: The numeric completion/age thresholds are baseline-justified before outcome collection; critical starvation keeps its existing target zero and is never relaxed by this contract.

outcomeBindings.sampleRule: Queue completion and age are recorded per work class for every admitted job; class labels stay the finite work-contract enums.
outcomeBindings.missingDataRule: A class with unavailable accounting is reported as unavailable, never as caught up; starvation above zero is a failure, not a caveat.

outcomeBindings.name: background grant/useful-progress/cancellation rates by platform

threshold.note: The numeric rate thresholds are baseline-justified per platform before outcome collection; numerical defaults are not invented before Q0.

outcomeBindings.sampleRule: Grant, useful-progress, and cancellation outcomes are counted per platform for every background opportunity, including the cancellations.
outcomeBindings.missingDataRule: A platform without runtime capability truth reports unavailable capability honestly instead of a foreground-only success; no fake background proof.

incompleteOutcomeRule.statement: No pilot may begin while any required outcome field is unspecified: a baseline-justified numeric threshold, sample rule, or missing-data rule for a bound outcome, or the cohort, observation window, denominator, or OFF comparator for the pilot scope. The fields are recorded in this contract before outcome collection, never after.

usefulnessNotSafetyOnly.statement: Usefulness outcomes measure whether the pilot delivered foreground/reconnect value; they never substitute for the E6 safety gates. E6 Critical-path regression ceilings, resource budgets, security and privacy gates remain nonwaivable, and metrics such as foreground latency/CPU contention under background work stay E6-owned rather than becoming pilot usefulness outcomes. Missing usefulness evidence holds only the affected expansion or claim; it never waives, replaces, or lowers an E6 gate.

expansionRule.statement: The retained pilot decision precedes expansion: the dossier records approved expansion, remain-at-current-cohort, rollback, or insufficient evidence with an accountable owner and reason before any cohort, platform, or capability scope widens. This contract grants no pilot execution or production enablement authority; flags stay OFF pending the separate enable decision.

capabilityProfileBinding.rule: The pilot binds frozen selected profiles only; results qualify only their exact frozen profile, and an unselected platform does not block an independent gate.

eligibleMailWorkflows: Foreground cached-list catch-up and reconnect on the internal native cohort.
Background metadata sync (delta/window) while the winning policy mode is execute.
Explicit attachment download and verified resume.
excludedWorkflows: Attachment prefetch stays never for the pilot unless explicitly widened.
No Drive/Chat/Meet offline/background execution and no production enablement without the separate cohort decision and evidence review.

cohort.rule: Internal native cohort: scoped policy mode execute, one platform unit at a time; policy scopes identify devices; no new telemetry identity or content is granted by this contract.

observationWindow.rule: Recorded in this contract before outcome collection; a pilot cannot begin while it remains unspecified, and it is never changed after results exist.

denominator.rule: Recorded in this contract before outcome collection as all pilot attempts with failures/timeouts/cancels/expiries retained separately; a pilot cannot begin while it remains unspecified.

offComparator.rule: Recorded in this contract before outcome collection as the corresponding flag-OFF comparator over the same frozen profile and workload; a pilot cannot begin while it remains unspecified.
